feeds.title: Sped Law Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest blogs and news on special education law blogs on Sped Law Blog.

feeds.title: The Wrightslaw Way Blog
feeds.description: Wrightslaw is the leading website about special education law and advocacy with thousands of articles, cases, and free resources about hundreds of special education topics, books by Peter Wright and Pamela Wright, and special education law and advocacy training.

feeds.title: Augustin Egelsee LLP Blog
feeds.description: Augustin Egelsee, LLP is a law firm that provides legal services to children in the areas of special education, suspensions, expulsions, IEP's and juvenile delinquency. The Augustin Egelsee L.L.P. blog shares Education Law stories and opinions relevant to California residents.

feeds.title: The Law Office of Meagan Nuñez Blog
feeds.description: The Law Office of Meagan Nuñez in San Diego is a full-service child advocacy firm committed to ensuring that children with disabilities obtain the meaningful education they deserve. Our lawyers have been deeply involved with special education in San Diego as both educators and legal advocates.

feeds.title: KGK Special Ed Law Blog
feeds.description: A blog to help Arizona students, parents and their families understand and navigate special education. Education law firm dedicated to representing students in matters relating to education, special education, higher education, disciplinary matters, IEPs, 504s, OCR.

feeds.title: Special Education Law Insights
feeds.description: The special education team at Franczek PC created this blog to provide timely, practical insights on special education law to school leaders. Franczek is the law firm of choice for Illinois schools, we concentrate on education, labor, and employment law, in both the public and private sectors.

feeds.title: Susan Clark Law Group Blog
feeds.description: Read the blog of Susan Clark Law Group LLC to learn about issues related to special education law. At Susan Clark Law Group LLC, our goal is to empower families by identifying and working to obtain the educational tools and supports they need for their children with special needs. Knowledge is power, and we help parents navigate the system to become strong and organized advocates for their children.

feeds.title: San Diego Special Education Law Blog
feeds.description: This blog, along with the content on the website, is designed to give you the knowledge you need to successfully navigate the special education system in San Diego and surrounding areas. The Law Office of Paul A. Hefley, Jr. is committed to answering your questions about California special education law and helping you address any issues you may be facing.

feeds.title: Coffee with Catherine Blog
feeds.description: Coffee with Catherine Blog is a dedicated to special education and parent advocacy.

feeds.title: Dayan Law Firm Blog
feeds.description: The Law Offices of Adam Dayan was started in 2009 with the primary purpose of representing families of children with special needs to pursue the rights and protections to which they are entitled. As a result, the firm predominantly focuses on representing parents of children with special needs in pursuing appropriate educational programs and services for their children under the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act.

feeds.title: Law Offices of Joseph M. Fein Blog
feeds.description: My name is Joseph M. Fein, and I understand the unique challenges facing children with disabilities and their families. With firsthand experience managing the difficult legal and practical issues facing the disabled, you can place your trust in my law firm for compassionate, effective and efficient counsel.
